top_signals.title: Oil Prices Dip but Hold Above $100 as Middle East Supply Threats Mount
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices began trading with a dip this week but remain significantly elevated as hostilities between Yemen’s Houthis and Saudi Arabia, as well as Iranian attacks on tankers in the Persian Gulf, continue. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $114.42 per barrel, down from over $116 per barrel last week but up from around $60 per barrel at the end of 2025. top_signals.title: The Pentagon's Rare Earth Deadline Is Almost Here. Is Anyone Ready?
top_signals.summary: For years, the rare earth industry has been talking about January 1, 2027 as the date that changes everything. That date is now less than 75 days away. On January 1, new Pentagon procurement rules take effect that will restrict the use of Chinese-origin rare earth materials in American weapons systems. The restrictions cover the full supply chain, from mining and refining through separation, melting, and production. Every defense contractor currently sourcing rare earth magnets or magnet materials from China will need a compliant domestic alternative.…

top_signals.title: HSBC’s Max Kettner Ends Bullish Stocks Call Ahead of Midterms
top_signals.summary: Max Kettner, among Wall Street’s most bullish strategists, is cutting back on his bet on stocks for the first time in months, arguing that sharp mood changes among investors warrant a more cautious approach ahead of next week’s US midterms.
